errors.evidence: The description does not state the purpose of the chart, which is to illustrate economic policy uncertainty in the USA.
The left y-axis range shown in the figure is 0 to 1000, not 1.000.
The right y-axis range shown in the figure is 0 to 9000, not 9.000.
The black line actually represents the overall economic policy, but the description should specify that it's from the left y-axis scale.
This part states that the blue line represents financial policy, but it needs to specify that it is also on the left y-axis.
This incorrectly states that the purple line represents trade policy on the right y-axis without drawing attention to the scale difference.
The description does not mention any units for the y-axis, which is crucial since it reflects an index, and does not clearly indicate the linear scale of the x-axis.
